result.summary: I've treated this as an emergency. The tenant wrote in Polish that water has been coming through the bathroom ceiling for about an hour and is near the socket by the mirror. I texted him safety advice in Polish, told the landlord by email and escalated to the operations team as high priority, because there's no contractor on record for me to send. I also recorded the tenant's language and the elderly neighbour in the flat above, moved the ticket to provider selection and set a 6-hour hold.
result.situation: Tenant Mr K. Nowak, Flat 3, 12 Bramble Gardens, Kingsfold ZZ6 4ZZ. WhatsApp message at 18:22 on 9 Oct 2026 (Polish), translated: "Good day, water has been coming from the bathroom ceiling into the bath for an hour, and an elderly lady lives upstairs. There is also water by the socket near the mirror. Please help, I don't know what to do. I can be home tomorrow after 2pm." The leak probably comes from the flat above, and the water near the socket is an electrical risk.

judgement.why_this_decision: Water near an electrical socket plus a leak that isn't contained counts as an emergency under our rules. The intake check agreed: emergency, safety risk 0.97. There's no contractor on record, so I couldn't send one myself. The safe steps were: give the tenant safety advice in his language, tell the landlord at the same time, and hand the call-out to a person as high priority.

alternatives_considered.option: Ask the landlord for approval first
alternatives_considered.why_not: Approval doesn't hold up emergency safety work. Waiting for it would leave the electrical risk in place.
There's no contractor on the ticket, at the property before, or named by the landlord. I won't invent one.

alternatives_considered.option: Book the visit for tomorrow after 14:00
alternatives_considered.why_not: The leak is active now and water is near the electrics. It can't wait until tomorrow.

escalation.reason: Emergency leak with water near the electrics, and no contractor on record to send
escalation.handover_summary: Water has been coming through the bathroom ceiling of Flat 3, 12 Bramble Gardens into the bath for about an hour, with water near the socket by the mirror. The source is probably the elderly neighbour's flat above. The tenant, who writes in Polish, has had safety advice by SMS. The landlord has had an emergency notice by email. No contractor or cost yet.
escalation.recommendation: Phone the tenant now, with a Polish speaker if possible, to confirm the electrics are off and the water has stopped. Send an emergency plumber tonight and an electrician to check the socket. Contact the block manager or the flat above, and do a welfare check on the elderly neighbour. Update the landlord on cost by phone.
